audits.tractability_implication: A scope filter can reduce parsing or candidate work but does not remove the codebook population traversal. ShapeDecode cache misses also enumerate the relation-cue population and its default expansion budget is 20,000. GenInfer restricts bases to two coordinate dimensions but performs four nested loops over a data-derived numeric bound B: up to (2B+1)^4 matrix candidates per eligible base. This is polynomial in B's numeric magnitude but can be exponential in the bit length of an unrestricted B; actual input distributions and per-call cost are not measured here.

audits.tractability_implication: This is local to the source term and render-language neighborhood when the language is well-formed, but per-element scan cost depends on rule count and tuple arity. Nested render is depth-capped; template decoding cost depends on its reachable Term subgraph.

claim_boundary: This source audit establishes static graph-access routes in the inspected implementations, not invocation frequency, elapsed cost, complete transitive call graphs, or frame-locality. The codebook population traversal is explicit. ProgEval's graph-resident decode and Join's graph-resident renderer are conditional on runtime values. No factor scopes or task-frame ownership are inferred.
